title: Lock a section of a Confluence page, keep the rest editable
subtitle: Seal one heading and what sits under it; edits by others are undone until you approve them

steps.label: Open the Sentinel Vault panel
steps.detail: Gabriela owns the page section 1. Introduction

steps.label: Click Seal a section
steps.detail: The picker reads the page's headings

steps.label: Pick the heading and how long
steps.detail: 1. Introduction for 1 day: the heading plus the blocks under it

steps.label: Section sealed until tomorrow
steps.detail: 1. Introduction · Sealed by you · until Thu 14:01

steps.label: A colleague edits the section
steps.detail: Mihai types test under 1. Introduction and publishes

steps.label: The edit is reverted
steps.detail: The page goes back to the sealed version (v48)

steps.label: The editor is told why
steps.detail: Your edit was undone; your text is kept in the page history

steps.label: Request edit on the section
steps.detail: Mihai asks Gabriela from the panel

steps.label: The owner approves
steps.detail: Mihai appears under Editors with access

callouts.text: Approved: Mihai may edit this section
